description: This Scala source file defines utility functions for managing and executing commands within the Spark deploy worker component, including process building, environment setup, and stream redirection.

classes.name: CommandUtils
classes.description: Object providing utility methods for command execution, environment setup, and stream redirection in Spark deploy worker.

methods.name: buildProcessBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a ProcessBuilder with specified command, environment, and configuration.

methods.name: buildCommandSeq
methods.description: Creates a sequence of command arguments for process execution, avoiding Windows run.cmd script.

methods.name: buildLocalCommand
methods.description: Prepares a Command object with environment variables and arguments tailored to the local environment and security settings.

methods.name: redirectStream
methods.description: Starts a thread to redirect an InputStream to a specified file, with error handling and logging.
